OCTOBEIZ 2024
ST MODWEN HOMES LIMITED
AND
TONBRIDGE AND MALLING BOROUGH COUNCIL
DEED OF VARIATION
under Section 106A of the Town and Country
Planning Act 1990 and all other enabling
powers relating to the Section 106 Agreement
dated 13th April 2021 for the development of
land south of Brampton Field between
Bradbourne Lane and Kiln Barn Road, Ditton,
Aylesford, Kent
GOWLING WLG
Tel +44 (0)370 903 1000 Fax +44 (0)370 904 1099 mail@gowling.com gowlingwlg.com
THIS DEED OF VARIATION is made the
3OTH
dayof OCTOBER
BETWEEN:
ST MODWEN HOMES LIMITED (company number 09095920) of Two Devon Way, Longbridge,
Birmingham, B31 2TS (the "Owner"); and
TONBRIDGE AND MALLING BOROUGH COUNCIL of Gibson Building, Gibson Drive, Kings
Hill, West Malling, Kent ME19 4LZ (the "Council").
(together the "Parties").
RECITALS:
The Council is the local planning authority for the purposes of the Act for the area within which
the Site is situated and the authority by whom the obligations varied in this Deed are
enforceable.
The Owner is the freehold owner of the Site pursuant to a transfer dated 23 December 2021
which is registered at the Land Registry under title number TT135218.
An agreement pursuant to section 106 of the Act dated 13 April 2021 supporting the Planning
Permission was made by (1) Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council and (2) the Kent County
Council and (3) The East Malling Trust (the "Original Obligation") and secured planning
obligations binding the Site.
The Owner has submitted a request to the Council to amend the Original Obligation in order to
deliver the Development in line with an amended affordable housing tenure mix.
The Parties hereto consider it expedient in the interests of the proper planning of the Site to
enter into this Deed for regulating and facilitating the Development.
NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH as folloWS:
DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this Deed and save where set out within this Deed al terms (including within
the Recitals) shall be given meaning as per Clause 1 of the Original Obligation and for the
avoidance of any doubt the Original Obligation shall remain in full force and effect save as varied
by this Deed.
CONSTRUCTION OF THIS DEED
Where in this Deed reference is made to any clause, paragraph or schedule or recital such
reference (unless the context otherwise requires) is a reference to a clause, paragraph or
schedule or recital in this Deed.
Words importing the singular meaning where the context so admits include the plural meaning
and vice versa.
Words of the masculine gender include the feminine and neuter genders and words denoting
actual persons include companies, corporations and firms and all such words shall be construed
interchangeable in that manner.
Wherever there is more than one person named as a party and where more than one party
undertakes an obligation all their obligations can be enforced against all of them jointly and
severally unless there is an express provision otherwise.
Any reference to an Act of Parliament shall include any modification, extension or re-enactment
of that Act for the time being in force and shall include all instruments, orders, plans regulations,
permissions and directions for the time being made, issued or given under that Act or deriving
validity from it.
References to any party to this Deed shall include the successors in title to that party and to any
person deriving title through or under that party and in the case of the Council the successors
to its statutory functions.
The headings and contents list are for reference only and shall not affect construction.
LEGAL BASIS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES
This Deed is made pursuant to Section 106A and Section 106 of the Act, Section 111 of the
Local Government Act 1972 and Section 1 of the Localism Act 2011 and all other enabling
powers.
The covenants, restrictions and requirements imposed upon the Parties under the Original
Obligation, as varied by this Deed, create planning obligations pursuant to Section 106 of the
1990 Act and are enforceable by the Council as local planning authority against the Owner and
its successors in title and assigns and any persons claiming under or through it.
The Parties covenant to observe and perform or cause to be observed and performed their
obligations contained in the Original Obligation as varied by this Deed.
CONDITIONALITY
This Deed shall come into effect upon the date of completion of this Deed.
CHANGES TO THE ORIGINAL AGREEMENT
The Original Obligation shall be amended as set out in the Schedule to this Deed.
MISCELLANEOUS
The Owner shall pay to the Council on completion of this Deed the reasonable legal costs of the
Council incurred in the negotiation, preparation, execution and completion of this Deed.
No provisions of this Deed shall be enforceable under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties)
This Deed shall be registrable as a local land charge by the Council.
Where the agreement, approval, consent or expression of satisfaction is required by the Parties
from the Council under the terms of this Deed such agreement, approval or consent or
expression of satisfaction shall not be unreasonably witheld or delayed. Any notices shall be
deemed to have been properly served if sent by recorded delivery to the principal address or
registered office (as appropriate) of the relevant party.
Insofar as any clause or clauses of this Deed are found (for whatever reason) to be invalid illegal
or unenforceable then such invalidity illegality or unenforceability shall not affect the validity or
enforceability of the remaining provisions of this Deed.
Nothing contained or implied in this Deed shal prejudice or affect the rights, discretions, powers,
duties and obligations of the Council under all statutes, by-laws, statutory instruments, orders
and regulations in the exercise of its functions as a local planning authority.
WAIVER
No waiver (whether expressed or implied) by the Council and/or the Owner of any breach or
default in performing or observing any of the covenants terms or conditions of this Deed shall
constitute a continuing waiver and no such waiver shall prevent the Council and/or the Owner
from enforcing any of the relevant terms or conditions or for acting upon any subsequent breach
or default.
JURISDICTION
This Deed is governed by and interpreted in accordance with the law of England and the parties
submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.
DELIVERY
The provisions of this Deed (other than this clause which shall be of immediate effect) shall be
of no effect until this Deed has been dated.
THE SCHEDULE
Variation of the Original Obligation
The Parties agree that the Original Obligation shall be amended as follows:
The definition of "Affordable Housing Dwellings" in the Original Obligation shall be deleted
and replaced with the following wording:
"Affordable Housing
means the Dwellings constructed on the Affordable Housing
Dwellings"
Land to be used for Affordable Housing being 25% (twenty five
percent) of the total number of Dwellings of which 50% (fifty
percent) shall be Affordable Rented Units and 50% (fifty
percent) shall be either Shared Ownership Units or
Intermediate Housing Units, such definition to be ascribed the
same meaning as contained in the Glossary to the National
Planning Policy Framework, or such other mix as otherwise
approved by the Council in writing (such approval not to be
unreasonably withheld or delayed)
The definition of "Affordable Rented Units" in the Original Obligation shall be deleted and
replaced with the following wording:
"Affordable Rented Units"
means the Affordable Housing Dwellings for rent provided at a
rent of no more than 80% (Eighty Per Cent) of the local market
rent (including service charges where applicable)
The definition of "Chargee" in the Original Obligation shall be amended by inserting the word
"Dwellings" after "Affordable Housing" so that the definition refers to "Affordable Housing
Dwellings".
A new clause 7.15 shall be inserted into the Original Obligation as follows:
"The Approved Housing Provider or Registered Provider (as applicable) or their successors in
title or mortgagees or Chargees shall have no liability under this Deed SAVE FOR compliance
with the Affordable Housing obligations in the Third Schedule Part 1 Paragraph 1 of this Deed."
A new clause 7.16 shall be inserted in to the Original Obligation as follows:
"The obligations contained in this Deed shall not be binding upon or enforceable against a
mortgagee or a chargee of the Site (in whole or part, including mortgagees of a Dwelling) until
it takes possession of the Site (in whole or part) in which case it too will be bound by the
obligations as if it were a party deriving title from the Owner."
Paragraph 1.5.1 of Part 1 of the Third Schedule (Affordable Housing) to the Original Obligation
shall be amended to read as follows:
"not be binding on a Chargee of an occupant or leaseholder in the event that such a Chargee
seeks to dispose of an Affordable Housing Dwelling pursuant to its power of sale exercised
pursuant to default of the terms of the mortgage APROVIDED THAT:
AS
such Chargee shall have first given writen notice to the Council of its intention to
dispose of the relevant Affordable Housing Dwelling(s) (such notice to include evidence
and written confirmation of the default) and shall have used reasonable endeavours
over a period of three months from the date of the written notice to complete a disposal
of the relevant Affordable Housing Dwelling(s) to another registered provider or to the
Council for a consideration not less than the amount due and outstanding under the
terms of the relevant security documentation including all accrued principal monies,
interest due and reasonable costs ; and
if such disposal has not completed within the three month period above, the Chargee
shall be entitled to dispose of the relevant Affordable Housing Dwelling(s) free from the
affordable housing provisions in this Deed which provisions shall determine absolutely";
Paragraph 1.5.2 to 1.5.4 of Part 1 of the Third Schedule (Affordable Housing) to the Original
Obligation shall be deleted and replaced with the following:
1.5.2 not be binding on any occupant of an Affordable Housing Dwelling who has exercised
a statutory right to acquire under the Housing Act 1996 or such other statutory right to buy or
acquire (including exercising any equivalent contractual right) or any mortgagee or successor
in title to that occupant; and
1.5.3 not be binding on a freeholder who was previously a leaseholder of an Affordable
Housing Dwelling who has exercised their right to staircase ownership up to 100% ownership
or any mortgagee or successor in title to that freeholder."
